# Controls (server)

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs` from the code. Edit the code comments, not this file. -->

The control library (including healthcare), the control register, the Statement of Applicability, traceability, Across Frameworks and Every Requirement.

## Files

- `control-import.ts`: Upload controls from a spreadsheet (CSV or Excel).
- `control-records.ts`: Turns control library and control register rows into API records.
- `control-routes.ts`: The engagement's control register: list, add, import from CSV or Excel, update.
- `harmonize.ts`: v1.7.3: cross-framework harmonization.
- `library-health.ts`: v1.7.3: healthcare AI governance.
- `library-routes.ts`: The control library and the obligations it meets.
- `library.ts`: Built-in control library, obligations and evaluation templates.
- `requirements.ts`: v1.7.4: every requirement of each framework in scope, and whether the engagement meets it.
- `soa-routes.ts`: The Statement of Applicability: which library controls apply to the engagement and why.
- `traceability-routes.ts`: Traceability: the chain from obligation to control, test and evidence.
